sloka: स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि ।किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम् ।। ७.७८.२० ॥
transliteration: sa hi tārayituṁ saumya śaktaḥ suragaṇānapi ।kiṁ punastvāṁ mahābāho kṣutpipāsāvaśaṁ gatam ।। 7.78.20 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, O gentle one, he is capable of saving even the hosts of gods; how much more so can he save you, O mighty-armed one, who have fallen under the sway of hunger and thirst?
